newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Hume makes takeover offer of CI Holdings.
newsitem.headline: Hume makes takeover offer of CI Holdings.

text.p: Hume Industries (M) Bhd said it was making a mandatory takeover offer of 25.94 million C.I. Holdings Bhd shares it does not already own at 8.50 ringgit a share.
Building products firm Hume said in a statement that it currently holds a 54.8 percent of the issued and paid-up capital of C.I. comprising 57.38 million shares.

It said a C.I. shareholder, state investment arm Permodalan Nasional Bhd (PNB), has said it would not be taking up the offer. PNB holds a 25.51 percent equity or 14.64 million shares in C.I., also a building products concern.
